interpretation.candidateMeaning: Item candidates are a broad structural cohort and are not yet equivalent to the current purchasable shop catalog.
interpretation.directProperties: m_mapAbilityProperties entries with m_eProvidedPropertyType are treated as candidate direct/always-on item stat substrate.
interpretation.modifierTokens: Record-wide MODIFIER_VALUE_* tokens may include conditional, passive, triggered, active or internal effects and are not assumed continuously active.
interpretation.inheritance: The `_base` field is preserved because effective metadata/stat definitions may depend on inheritance.
interpretation.purchaseability: Purchaseability and shop visibility will be resolved from the discovered field schema rather than inferred from record names alone.
interpretation.nameSignals: Test/template-like record-name matches are diagnostic only and do not exclude records.
